The full suite is green (BUILD SUCCESS).

The change is minimal and contained to a single file. I edited `OwnerAuditListener.onCreate` to add `membershipNumber={}` to the log format and a small private helper `membershipNumber(Owner)` that mirrors the format used by the mapper (`customerCode + "-M" + 2-digit registration year`). The previously logged fields—id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel—all remain. The audit line now reads, e.g.:

```
owner created id=11 customerCode=NSW-16E6609E registrationDate=2026-09-02 membershipLevel=2 membershipNumber=NSW-16E6609E-M26
```
